name: com.pdftron.pdf.utils.PDFTronToolsInitializer
description: Apryse (PDFTron) PDF Tools initializes the PDF engine for the app at startup using the configured license; when no license is present, it attempts to request a trial key. This makes the library’s PDF viewing and editing tools ready to use.
disableEffect: Disabling it leaves Apryse’s PDF tools uninitialized, so documents that depend on them will not open or process correctly.
